verdict.rationale: Once you approve the plan, ReelMimic runs a multi-agent production pipeline on its own: up to 6 builder agents work in parallel, separate agents review each shot, and a log shows what each one did. Jobs that hit a limit pause and resume. The post-video command also supports scheduled publishing at a set time (--at/--tz), but there is no evidence of user-defined recurring or triggered automations. missing for 10: user-configurable recurring/triggered automation workflows, documented unattended background/daemon operation, independent hands-on corroboration.
